caption: The drawing features a headless, armless male mannequin dressed in 18th-century attire, composed of a deep maroon or burgundy frock coat which has large cuffs, pocket flaps, and a row of silver or gray buttons along the front and on the cuffs. Underneath, there is a light-colored, possibly cream or white, embroidered waistcoat with detailed buttons, along with a white ruffled shirt protruding at the collar. The lower body is dressed in tan breeches that extend just above the knee, with white stockings below them. The coat appears to be made of a satin-like, slightly reflective fabric, giving it a sheen. Off to the upper right of the central colored illustration, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the frock coat shown from the rear, highlighting the same garment structure with back seams, cuffs, and pocket placements. The background is plain and light tan, fading toward a brighter cream color at the bottom.
title: Man's Suit
